capabilities: create and manage multiple book projects with templates and custom covers
organize chapters in a draggable tree with status markers and folder structure
track word counts, daily writing gains, and goal completion
run pomodoro focus sessions with configurable work/break durations and interruption stats
manage citations with auto-numbering and bibliography generation, and export to PDF with cover, headers, and table of contents
extras: Interface available in Simplified Chinese and English. PDF preview and export are desktop-only (Electron-dependent); the plugin requires Obsidian 1.4.10+. Cross-device sync of book files is left to the user's vault sync solution. Author accepts donations via WeChat, Alipay, and Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for managing long-form book projects with chapter trees, status tracking, writing statistics, and manuscript-ready export.
summary: Writing project manager that organizes books into templated chapters, tracks word-count progress, runs pomodoro focus sessions, and exports manuscripts to PDF.
